# BB00166: Ziyarat for Hadrat-i-Quddus {.unnumbered}

In the Name of the Most High, the Most Great, the Most Exalted

O Pure and Most Luminous Essence, Who rose and shone forth, then gleamed and flashed, then dawned and resounded, then illumined and ascended from the lights of the holy splendor near the garment of the countenance of the One, the Single, the Unique, the Eternal, and Muhammad, peace be upon Him and His family, His servant, the first number in the world of eternity, and the Manifestations of His Beloved's Self, the essential sustainers in the everlasting realm.

Upon thee, O Light of Glory, Remembrance of Creation, Mystery of Destiny, Guide of Implementation, Camphor of Praise, Mount Sinai, and Appearance of the Crimson Pillar, by the essence of my heart and by what God, my Lord, loves.

Then upon thee, O Point of the Gates, Reality of the Book, Word of the Bestower, Sign of the Oft-Returning, Center of the Circle of the Poles, the Countenance veiled in the House of Response, and the Universal Trial for the perfection of causes, by my pure being and by what God, my Master, loves.

Then upon thee, O Thou Who proves the Essence by the Essence for the Essence, and the Beauty of Attributes in all manifestations, conditions, signs and evidences, by the light of my essence and by what God, my Sovereign, loves.

Then upon thee, O Bearer of Succor, the One humbled before the Help in Peril, transformed by life, penetrating through gentleness, and drawing near through supplication at the time of calling for help to God, the Help in Peril, by the glory of my soul and by what God, my King, loves.

Then upon thee, O Blazing Lamp, Stirrer of Joy, Ocean surging with waves, Heaven adorned with constellations, Light shining at the time of ascension, Tumultuous Light in the pitch darkness of commotion, and Straightener of crookedness in the station of agitation, by the camphor of my being and by what God, my Beloved, loves.

Then upon thee, O Radiant Star, Swimming Planet, Successful Light, Sincere Servant, Manifest Glory, Refreshing Wind, and Pure Righteous One, by the essence of my element and by what God, my Intended One, loves.

Then upon thee, O Lofty Throne, Firm Spirit, Diffusing Light, Towering Mountain, Flowing Earth, Blowing Trump, and Crying Servant, by my father and what lies within my Lord's knowledge.

Then upon thee, O Essence of the Heart, Progress of Creation, Quickener of Lands, Inspirer of Truth, Guide of Servants, Elucidator of Guidance, and the One exalted above opposites, by my father and what lies within my Lord's knowledge.

Then upon thee, O Thou in Whom I seek refuge and to Whom I flee, from Whose decree there is no escape, for neither I nor anyone has any deviation from Thee, and Thou art the refuge for all who seek protection in Thy presence and then take shelter in Thy court, by my father and what lies within my Lord's knowledge.

Upon thee, O Inscribed Book, Famous Delicate Symbol, Frequented House, Camphor Leaf, Hidden Secret, and Manifest Light, by my father and what lies within my Lord's knowledge.

Then upon thee, O Adorned Ornament, Ultimate Symbol, Final Mystery in the pole of the circle of the center, Embellished Glory, Adorned Radiance, Most Beautiful Ornaments, and Essential Jewel, by my father and what lies within my Lord's knowledge.

Then upon thee, O Light of Holiness, Spirit of Fellowship, Mystery of the All-Holy, King of Paradise, Sovereign of Heaven, and Warbling Peacock in the essences of the ocean, from Whose dominion no decree of the most precious souls can flee, and compared to Whom in His heart the finest horseman is but of the nature of darkness, a dry stone, a blazing meteor, and a pitch-dark night, by my father and what lies within my Lord's knowledge.

Then upon Thee, O Provider of sustenance by God's leave, and Ruler over all flocks, and Nurturer of nestlings, and Quencher of all who thirst, and Bestower of raiment upon mankind, and the Smiling, the Cheerful One, by my soul and all within my Lord's knowledge!

Then upon Thee, O Master of refuge, and the Powerful to deliver, and Witness to absorption, and Ruler over young camels, and Judge between people and the recoilers, and the Living Spirit in bodies, by my soul and all within my Lord's knowledge!

Then upon Thee, O Best of substitutes, and Master of gardens, and the Bountiful Sovereign, and Remover of diseases, and Witness to all red and white, for I testify that Thy word is effective and Thy decree decisive, by my soul and all within my Lord's knowledge!

Then upon Thee, O Light of the earth, and the All-encompassing Knowledge, and the Extended Justice, and the Straight Line, and the Central Point, and the Outspread Sustenance, and the Secret Path on the Day of Equity, by my soul and all within my Lord's knowledge!

Then upon Thee, O Preserved Tablet, and the Protected Book, and the Observed Letter, and the Seer of glances, and the Hearer of utterances, and the Distributor of portions, and the Witness to the spoken word, by my soul and all within my Lord's knowledge!

Then upon Thee, O All-Gathering Name, and the Fourth Symbol, and the Decisive Judgment, and the Rising Sun, and the Protective Veil, and the Seeing, Hearing One, and the Brilliant, Radiant Light, by my soul and all within my Lord's knowledge! O Thou Who hast witnessed and bestowed abundantly, and shown compassion and permitted, and carried and delivered, and spoken and poured forth, and saw and completed, and heard and found pleasing, and beheld and rejected not, by my soul and all within my Lord's knowledge!

Then upon Thee, O Thou Just and Mighty Sovereign, and the Kind King, and the Compassionate Monarch, and the Surging, Overflowing, Protected Ocean, Refuge of the weak, Support of the distressed, and the Upright, Inclined Alif, by my soul and all within my Lord's knowledge!

Then upon Thee, O True Reality, and the Precise Absolute Mystery, and the Deep Surging Ocean, and the Brilliant Firm Pillar, and the Elevated Ancient House, and the Delicate Shining Light, and the Compassionate Gleaming Glory, by my soul and all within my Lord's knowledge!

Then upon Thee, O King of the Kingdom, and Sovereign of sovereigns, and the Merciful to the possessed, and the Ordainer of ways of conduct, and the Established Pole in the depths of the spheres, and the Witness to the perceiving wayfarer—Thou art He Whom perception cannot perceive, by my soul and all within my Lord's knowledge!

Then upon Thee, O Oceans of majesty, and Mine of grandeur, and Sovereign of bounties, and the Powerful over deeds, and the Exalted in impossibilities, and the Condescending in annihilation, and the Witness to the end, by my soul and all within my Lord's knowledge! I testify that Thou art the Most Ancient Light, and the Greatest Name, and the Delicate Symbol, and the Most Noble Sign, and the Most Perfect Remembrance, and the Most Decisive Radiance, and the Most Upright Glory, by my soul and all within my Lord's knowledge!

Then upon Thee, O Tree of the Bayan, and Mystery of the Qur'an, and Glory of Paradise, and Unseen of contingent being, and Manifestness of creation, and Appearance of the All-Merciful, by my soul and all within my Lord's knowledge!

Then upon Thee, O Mystery of transcendence, and Symbol of exaltation, and the Effective in nearness, through Whom the valley bestows without Thee the mention of effacement and the mystery of consciousness without the remembrance of trees, no hearing of vain decree, by my soul and all within my Lord's knowledge!

Then upon Thee, O Light of the Divine Identity, and Garment of the Countenance of Oneness, and Mystery of Eternality, and the Divine Grandeur, and the Glory of the Divine Essence, and the Sublimity of the Realm of Might, and [...] praise be upon my father and what is in my Lord's knowledge!

Then upon you be the letter "la" and the word "illa" and the mystery of "la" and "la illa," for through you has shone forth what has illumined, and through you is cast the majesty of my father and what is in my Lord's knowledge.

Then upon you, O Remembrance of the Most High, Praise of the Manifest, Glory of the Hidden, Splendor of the Concealed, the Faithful Name, the Pure Light, and the Fresh Book! I bear witness before God and what is in His knowledge that there is no God but Him, alone with no partner. His is the Kingdom and Command, there is no God but Him, the Great, the Exalted.

And I bear witness to Muhammad, peace be upon him and his family and upon their followers, and to the Manifestations of His Self, as He Himself has testified to them in His knowledge, and none can comprehend their knowledge save Him. There is no God but Him, the Mighty, the Sublime, the Gracious.

And I bear witness to all that God's knowledge encompasses, as He numbers it and as He loves and is pleased with. And I bear witness before You of the greatest causes and the mightiest outcomes, that every essential attribute, abstract description, manifest remembrance, and camphor mystery of the exaltation of God's Cause in You and before You is pure falsehood.

Thus do I seek Your forgiveness as You love and are pleased with, and I turn to You in repentance as You reckon. For my very existence in Your dominion is pure sin, so how much more when sin acquires another sin? Therefore grant me, O Sovereign of my heart, Sultan of my being, Master of my secret and my public self, what proceeds from Your generosity and grace, for the cause of Your gifts and bounties is Your munificence and nothing else. Bestow Your grace upon me, for verily You are the Generous, the Sublime, the All-Giving.
